# [Implementation] - [Phase 6] [Bug] Lifecycle exit contracts are false: TRIAGE outlives the merged PR, and the collector-branch closing caveat is silent unless --issue was passed

## 1. Context

- Smoke section extracted from the archived #351 plan at #364; the body is omitted.

### Manual Smoke Test Protocol

Run every block from the worktree root, **after `npm run build`** (Quality Gate target 1) — `bin/codeloop.js` executes `dist/` and refuses a stale build. Each block is self-contained, writes only inside its own `$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-351-*` sandbox (`SMOKE_SANDBOX_MANDATE`; a sandbox under `/tmp` is refused by the state guard unless `NODE_TEST_CONTEXT` is set), and destroys it at the end. `env -u AGY_SUBAGENT` is required: the harness sets it and every state-mutating command refuses to run under it.

The gate does not run these blocks in isolation: `SmokeProtocol.toScript()` concatenates every fenced body into ONE `set -e` script. So each block (a) starts from `$REPO_ROOT` rather than trusting the caller's cwd, (b) **never calls `exit`** (that would skip the remaining checks), (c) records the command's own status, and (d) ends with `[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]` so a failed assertion aborts the script and is attributed to this check. Each failure prints a single `FAIL: …` line, which is what the gate reports back.

**S1 — a `MERGED` PR ends the TRIAGE gate (the #349 timeline, replayed)**

```bash
set -u
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SMOKE=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-351-next-XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$SMOKE"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$SMOKE/.agyloop/tasks" "$SMOKE/.bin"
cat > "$SMOKE/.bin/gh" <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
case "$*" in
  *"pr list"*)
    echo '[{"number":7,"title":"Task #351","body":"Closes #351","state":"MERGED","mergedAt":"2026-10-28T00:00:00Z","baseRefName":"main","headRefName":"task/351","url":"https://example.test/pull/7","labels":[]}]'
    ;;
  *) echo '' ;;
esac
SH
chmod +x "$SMOKE/.bin/gh"
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
cat > "$SMOKE/.agyloop/tasks/351.json" <<JSON
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "currentStage": "TRIAGE",
  "mode": "standard",
  "issue": 351,
  "baseBranch": "main",
  "triagePayload": "- [reviewer]: please fix the nil dereference",
  "createdAt": "$NOW",
  "updatedAt": "$NOW",
  "history": [{ "stage": "TRIAGE", "timestamp": "$NOW" }],
  "pausedAtGate": "TRIAGE",
  "pausedAtTimestamp": "$NOW",
  "totalHumanWaitMs": 0
}
JSON
cd "$SMOKE"
git init -q
git config user.email smoke@test
git config user.name smoke
git remote add origin git@github.com:owner/repo.git
NEXT_STATUS=0
PATH="$SMOKE/.bin:$PATH" env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 351 --json > "$SMOKE/out.json" 2> "$SMOKE/err.txt" || NEXT_STATUS=$?
STATUS=0
NEXT_STATUS="$NEXT_STATUS" STATE="$SMOKE/.agyloop/tasks/351.json" REPORT="$SMOKE/out.json" ERR="$SMOKE/err.txt" node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
if (Number(process.env.NEXT_STATUS) !== 0) {
  fail("codeloop next exited " + process.env.NEXT_STATUS + ": " + fs.readFileSync(process.env.ERR, "utf8"));
}
const out = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.REPORT, "utf8"));
const state = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.STATE, "utf8"));
const err = fs.readFileSync(process.env.ERR, "utf8");
if (out.currentStage !== "COMPLETED") fail("directive stage " + out.currentStage);
if (out.actionType !== "completed") fail("actionType " + out.actionType);
if (out.role) fail("still names a role: " + out.role);
if (out.invocationPayload) fail("still carries a dispatch payload");
if (out.pause !== null) fail("still reports a pause: " + JSON.stringify(out.pause));
if (JSON.stringify(out).includes("Invoke Triage")) fail("still a triage directive");
if (/codeloop resume/.test(err)) fail("still tells the operator to resume");
if (state.currentStage !== "COMPLETED") fail("persisted stage " + state.currentStage);
if (state.pausedAtGate !== null) fail("pause not consumed: " + state.pausedAtGate);
if (state.triagePayload !== null) fail("stale triage payload kept");
const last = state.history[state.history.length - 1];
if (!last.metadata || last.metadata.triageExit !== "pr-terminal") fail("no triageExit metadata: " + JSON.stringify(last));
if (last.metadata.prState !== "MERGED") fail("prState " + last.metadata.prState);
if (!/Triage gate ended: PR #7 is MERGED\./.test(out.humanSummary)) fail("idle report does not say why: " + out.humanSummary);
console.log("OK S1: merged PR -> COMPLETED / idle, pause consumed, exit recorded");
' || STATUS=$?
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
rm -rf "$SMOKE"
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S2 — an `OPEN` PR still yields the triage directive (the gate is not weakened)**

```bash
set -u
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SMOKE=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-351-open-XXXXXX")
trap 'rm -rf "$SMOKE"' EXIT
mkdir -p "$SMOKE/.agyloop/tasks" "$SMOKE/.bin"
cat > "$SMOKE/.bin/gh" <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
case "$*" in
  *"pr list"*)
    echo '[{"number":7,"title":"Task #351","body":"Closes #351","state":"OPEN","mergedAt":null,"baseRefName":"main","headRefName":"task/351","url":"https://example.test/pull/7","labels":[]}]'
    ;;
  *) echo '' ;;
esac
SH
chmod +x "$SMOKE/.bin/gh"
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
cat > "$SMOKE/.agyloop/tasks/351.json" <<JSON
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "currentStage": "TRIAGE",
  "mode": "standard",
  "issue": 351,
  "baseBranch": "main",
  "triagePayload": "- [reviewer]: please fix the nil dereference",
  "createdAt": "$NOW",
  "updatedAt": "$NOW",
  "history": [{ "stage": "TRIAGE", "timestamp": "$NOW" }],
  "pausedAtGate": "TRIAGE",
  "pausedAtTimestamp": "$NOW",
  "totalHumanWaitMs": 0
}
JSON
cd "$SMOKE"
git init -q
git config user.email smoke@test
git config user.name smoke
git remote add origin git@github.com:owner/repo.git
NEXT_STATUS=0
PATH="$SMOKE/.bin:$PATH" env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" next --issue 351 --json > "$SMOKE/out.json" 2>/dev/null || NEXT_STATUS=$?
STATUS=0
NEXT_STATUS="$NEXT_STATUS" STATE="$SMOKE/.agyloop/tasks/351.json" REPORT="$SMOKE/out.json" node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); process.exit(1); };
if (Number(process.env.NEXT_STATUS) !== 0) fail("codeloop next exited " + process.env.NEXT_STATUS);
const out = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.REPORT, "utf8"));
const state = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.STATE, "utf8"));
if (out.currentStage !== "TRIAGE") fail("an open PR must keep the gate, got " + out.currentStage);
if (out.role !== "triage") fail("role " + out.role);
if (!out.invocationPayload) fail("the triage directive must still carry its payload");
if (!/merged\/closed/.test(out.description)) fail("exit condition text lost");
if (state.currentStage !== "TRIAGE") fail("persisted stage " + state.currentStage);
if (state.pausedAtGate !== "TRIAGE") fail("pause " + state.pausedAtGate);
console.log("OK S2: open PR -> TRIAGE directive, checkpoint untouched");
' || STATUS=$?
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
rm -rf "$SMOKE"
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S3 — the collector caveat fires with no `--issue` (the #350 invocation)**

```bash
set -u
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/agyloop"
SMOKE=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/.cache/agyloop/smoke-351-caveat-XXXXXX")
BARE="$SMOKE-origin.git"
trap 'rm -rf "$SMOKE" "$BARE"' EXIT
cd "$SMOKE"
git init -q
git config user.email smoke@test
git config user.name smoke
printf '.agyloop/\nartifacts/\n.bin/\n' > .gitignore
printf 'x\n' > README.md
git add -A
git commit -qm 'chore: seed'
git checkout -qb task/351
git init -q --bare "$BARE"
git remote add origin "$BARE"
mkdir -p .bin .home artifacts/plans/351-smoke .agyloop/tasks
cat > .bin/gh <<'SH'
#!/bin/sh
case "$*" in
  *"pr list"*) echo '[]' ;;
  *"pr create"*) printf '%s\n' "$*" >> "$GH_CALL_LOG"; echo 'https://example.test/pull/12' ;;
  *"pr view"*) echo 'https://example.test/pull/12' ;;
  *) echo '' ;;
esac
SH
chmod +x .bin/gh
printf '# [Implementation] - Smoke\n\n- [ ] Step 1: probe\n' > artifacts/plans/351-smoke/implementation_plan.md
cp "$REPO_ROOT/templates/summary-log.md" "artifacts/plans/351-smoke/CodeLoop Summary.md"
printf 'y\n' >> README.md
NOW=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
cat > .agyloop/tasks/351.json <<JSON
{
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "currentStage": "COMMIT",
  "mode": "standard",
  "issue": 351,
  "baseBranch": "phase/6-smoke",
  "planDir": "artifacts/plans/351-smoke",
  "worktree": { "taskId": 351, "worktreePath": "$SMOKE", "branch": "task/351", "baseBranch": "phase/6-smoke", "isIsolated": false },
  "createdAt": "$NOW",
  "updatedAt": "$NOW",
  "history": [{ "stage": "COMMIT", "timestamp": "$NOW" }],
  "pausedAtGate": "COMMIT",
  "pausedAtTimestamp": "$NOW",
  "totalHumanWaitMs": 0
}
JSON
COMMIT_STATUS=0
GH_CALL_LOG="$SMOKE/gh-calls.log" PATH="$SMOKE/.bin:$PATH" HOME="$SMOKE/.home" env -u AGY_SUBAGENT node "$REPO_ROOT/bin/codeloop.js" commit --create-pr -y --keep-worktree -m 'fix: probe (#351)' > "$SMOKE/out.txt" 2>&1 || COMMIT_STATUS=$?
STATUS=0
COMMIT_STATUS="$COMMIT_STATUS" LOG="$SMOKE/out.txt" CALLS="$SMOKE/gh-calls.log" node -e '
const fs = require("fs");
const out = fs.readFileSync(process.env.LOG, "utf8");
const calls = fs.existsSync(process.env.CALLS) ? fs.readFileSync(process.env.CALLS, "utf8") : "";
const fail = (m) => { console.error("FAIL: " + m); console.error(out); process.exit(1); };
if (Number(process.env.COMMIT_STATUS) !== 0) fail("codeloop commit exited " + process.env.COMMIT_STATUS);
if (!/Successfully committed/.test(out)) fail("commit did not run");
const create = calls.split("\n").find((l) => l.startsWith("pr create"));
if (!create) fail("no gh pr create was executed; log: " + calls);
if (!/--body Closes #351/.test(create)) fail("the PR body does not name #351: " + create);
if (!/Closing keyword caveat: this PR targets the collector branch .phase\/6-smoke./.test(out)) fail("the collector caveat is silent on the flag-less path");
if (!/Closes #351. will not auto-close the issue on merge\. Run .codeloop sync. after the merge to close it\./.test(out)) fail("the caveat does not name the keyword nor the compensator");
console.log("OK S3: flag-less commit warns about the collector base, and the body really carries Closes #351");
' || STATUS=$?
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
rm -rf "$SMOKE" "$BARE"
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```

**S4 — the four documentation surfaces agree with both behaviours**

```bash
set -eu
REPO_ROOT="${REPO_ROOT:-$PWD}"
cd "$REPO_ROOT"
HELP_FILE=$(mktemp)
trap 'rm -f "$HELP_FILE"' EXIT
STATUS=0
node bin/codeloop.js --help > "$HELP_FILE"
for pattern in "MERGED/CLOSED" "exits to COMPLETED" "does NOT auto-close" "closes the issue after the merge"; do
  grep -qF "$pattern" "$HELP_FILE" || { echo "FAIL: --help does not state '$pattern'"; STATUS=1; }
done
for f in skills/agyloop/SKILL.md integrations/opencode/codeloop-skill.md; do
  grep -qi "merged or closed" "$f" || { echo "FAIL: $f does not document the TRIAGE exit condition"; STATUS=1; }
  grep -qi "auto-close" "$f" || { echo "FAIL: $f does not document the collector caveat"; STATUS=1; }
  grep -qi "closing keyword" "$f" || { echo "FAIL: $f does not name the closing keyword"; STATUS=1; }
done
grep -qi "auto-close" README.md || { echo "FAIL: README.md does not document the collector caveat"; STATUS=1; }
grep -qi "closing keyword" README.md || { echo "FAIL: README.md does not name the closing keyword"; STATUS=1; }
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ] && echo "OK S4: help, both skills and README agree with both behaviours"
[ "$STATUS" -eq 0 ]
```
